entries: The {rival} had posed as {first}'s guide, out of {MOTIVE}.
The chart led nowhere, because {the_someone:human} had inked it {MANNER} to send rivals astray.
{the_thing:valuable} had never been kept at {landmark}; {SOMEONE:human,!plural} had carried it off {MANNER}.
No accident caused {the_disaster:strikes}; {the_someone:human} had arranged it, out of {MOTIVE}.
{CLOSE:human} had passed the route to the {rival}, out of {MOTIVE}.
The true treasure was {PRIZE:inner}, as {the_someone:human} had known from the start.
{the_thing:portable} was a copy, and {the_someone:human} kept the original {HIDING}.
The ruins at {landmark:built} were a stage set, built {MANNER} by {the_someone:human}.
{first} had camped beside {the_thing:!living} {HIDING} three nights earlier, and the {rival} knew.
{the_someone:human} had joined the race for {MOTIVE}, never for {PRIZE:material}.
The {rival} was only a decoy; {the_someone:human} ran the real race {MANNER}.
